description: Clean narration of two short paragraphs; recogniser output lower-case without punctuation.
segments: The lighthouse keeper woke before dawn, as he always did.
He climbed the narrow stairs, counting each step under his breath.
At the top, the great lamp waited for him like an old friend.
Outside, the sea was calm and grey.
A single gull circled the rocks below, crying into the wind.
He wiped the glass, trimmed the wick, and watched the horizon turn from black to silver.
